name: TikMnG Özgün Sentetik Ses Efektleri Başlangıç Paketi
origin: Original programmatic oscillator and seeded-noise synthesis created for TikMnG; not TikOyun assets.

rights.statement: Created for TikMnG from scratch. No third-party recordings, samples, music, melodies, models or sound libraries were used.
rights.permission: These original generated effects may be used, copied, modified and redistributed with TikMnG and in games, videos and live streams, including commercial use. No attribution is required.
rights.affiliation: Not sourced from, licensed by or affiliated with TikOyun.

generator: tools/build-sound-effects.cjs (Node.js built-ins only; deterministic xorshift32 noise)
preview: Resolve each registered file relative to renderer/assets/sound-effects/. No network access is needed.

sounds.title: Hediye bildirimi
sounds.description: Four bright glass droplets bloom into a soft sparkling tail for a received gift.
sounds.synthesis: Inharmonic sine partials at 784, 1176, 1568 and 2093 Hz; staggered strikes and short reflections.

sounds.title: Zafer
sounds.description: A quick warm brass lift resolves into one compact celebratory chord.
sounds.synthesis: Soft additive brass strikes, two rising pickups and a three-voice final hit with low reinforcement.

sounds.title: Kaybetme
sounds.description: A rubbery low pitch collapses with a wobble and a quiet dry rattle.
sounds.synthesis: Descending 310-to-73 Hz triangle glide, phase vibrato and seeded band-limited rattle.

sounds.title: Geri sayım
sounds.description: Three evenly spaced clock pips end in a brighter, longer go signal.
sounds.synthesis: Three 760 Hz sine/triangle pips at 320 ms intervals; final 1520/2280 Hz go pair.

sounds.title: Turbo
sounds.description: An accelerating engine buzz rushes upward through a grainy air sweep.
sounds.synthesis: Three-harmonic exponential 95-to-1850 Hz sweep, accelerating pulse envelope and filtered seeded noise.

sounds.title: Gerilim
sounds.description: A deep synthetic impact supports a tense metallic stab and a dark tail.
sounds.synthesis: 105-to-39 Hz descending kick, dissonant 146.83/155.56/220 Hz FM voices and a seeded noise impact.

sounds.title: Yayın uyarısı
sounds.description: Two crisp alternating electronic double-pulses cut through a busy stream.
sounds.synthesis: Four separated 920/1360 Hz odd-harmonic pulses with short rounded gates.

sounds.title: Coin
sounds.description: A tiny double metallic ping jumps upward and rings out quickly.
sounds.synthesis: 1180/1730 Hz sine strikes with decaying 3.41-ratio FM overtones; offset by 67 ms.

sounds.title: Baloncuk
sounds.description: A short hollow bubble plop with a tiny breathy snap.
sounds.synthesis: Curved 920-to-125 Hz sine drop, weak subharmonic and a 22 ms filtered noise transient.

sounds.title: Lazer
sounds.description: A sharp sci-fi shot falls through a resonant, lightly echoed tail.
sounds.synthesis: 2600-to-180 Hz exponential phase-modulated sweep, 37 Hz amplitude ripple and two short echoes.
